# Documentation Instructions

- Every artifact must reference traceability IDs from requirements.md (US-n, FR-n, NFR-n).
- Keep sections short and scannable: headings, bullet points, small tables. Avoid prose walls.
- Never remove the ## Outcome / ## Notes sections used for review sign-off.
- Regenerate impacted artifacts whenever requirements.md changes; do not hand-edit generated sections directly.
- Use consistent Markdown heading levels (# for title, ## for sections) across all artifacts.
